name: Wah Lee Industrial Corporation
summary: Wah Lee Industrial Corporation engages in the import and export trade, and agency business of composite materials, engineering and functional plastics, semiconductor process materials, printed circuit board process equipment, optoelectronic products, and industrial materials in Taiwan. It also engages in the engineering of plastic raw materials and composite materials, industrial materials, and equipment; provision of freight and leasing services; manufacturing of synthetic resins, industrial plastics, mold machinery and equipment, and chemical materials; and solar power generation businesses. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
